name: @taproot/astro
description: The Taproot client for Astro: read content from a Taproot server over HTTP
//: The CONSUMER half. A site installs this and nothing else; it holds an API key and talks to a Taproot server over HTTP. It deliberately does not depend on @taproot/core's main entry — that barrel pulls Kysely and the dialect loaders, none of which a site can use and all of which it would ship. Runtime imports go to @taproot/core/pure, which compiles to a re-export of the crop arithmetic and nothing else; everything else is `import type`, erased at build. The server is @taproot/studio and is not installed here.
